quests.dispatcherQuestion: Chemical weapons synthesis route detected in intercepted intelligence data. Input code!
quests.hint: Intercept and report the CW intelligence immediately.
quests.explanation: Chemical weapons intelligence intercepts trigger non-proliferation treaty verification protocols and allied notification.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Source laboratory in a non-treaty nation requires coordinated international action. Input code!
quests.hint: Identify and report on the source laboratory.
quests.explanation: Source laboratory identification enables diplomatic pressure, sanctions, or OPCW inspection requests before production escalates.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International treaty organization requiring formal notification of the identified threat. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue formal OPCW notification.
quests.explanation: OPCW formal notifications initiate treaty verification procedures that bring international authority to bear on the situation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Radiological accident in a major hospital requiring a full facility response. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the hospital radiological emergency code.
quests.explanation: Hospital radiological codes direct nuclear medicine staff to isolate sources and escort radiation-naive staff to safe areas.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Unsealed radioactive source in contact with ten patients requiring dose assessment. Input code!
quests.hint: Assess radiation doses for all ten patients.
quests.explanation: Individual dose assessment guides treatment decisions, as high doses require specific medical interventions like bone marrow support.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hospital decontamination needed before normal clinical operations can resume. Input code!
quests.hint: Begin hospital decontamination operations.
quests.explanation: Hospital decontamination surveys and cleans all surfaces, ensuring residual contamination does not affect future patients.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineered pathogen with aerosol transmission detected in a bioterror threat report. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate alpha level bioterror threat response.
quests.explanation: Alpha level bioterror responses deploy specialist CBRN teams with agent-specific protective equipment and treatment protocols.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Aerosolized pathogen potentially dispersed in the public transport network. Input code!
quests.hint: Lock down the biological transit threat.
quests.explanation: Transit network lockdowns prevent ongoing dispersal and allow systematic decontamination of all affected vehicles and stations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Medical research community worldwide alerted to begin developing a targeted treatment. Input code!
quests.hint: Alert the global medical research community.
quests.explanation: Global medical alerts accelerate parallel development of treatments by sharing genome sequences, clinical data, and trial results.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Container ship losing stability in a storm with 32 crew members missing overboard. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate the maritime mass overboard response.
quests.explanation: Mass overboard responses coordinate multiple surface vessels and aircraft in pattern searches covering the drift area.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Multiple distress beacon signals detected across a 50-mile ocean sector. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the beacon grid search pattern.
quests.explanation: Grid search patterns guided by beacon signals maximize the probability of locating distributed survivors quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Severe weather preventing helicopter operations in the search zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Restrict search operations to SAR vessels only.
quests.explanation: Surface-only SAR in severe weather uses vessels with radar and thermal imaging to continue the search safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National critical infrastructure protection plan being activated for the first time. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the national infrastructure protection plan.
quests.explanation: Infrastructure protection plans distribute hardened security to power, water, financial, and communications sectors simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Both cyber and physical threat vectors are active against the infrastructure. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the hybrid threat defense protocol.
quests.explanation: Hybrid threat protocols counter simultaneous cyber and physical attacks by coordinating digital and physical security teams.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency security legislation needed to authorize full protective measures. Input code!
quests.hint: Invoke the emergency legislative powers.
quests.explanation: Emergency powers provide legal authority for extraordinary protective measures that peacetime law does not permit.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Space debris confirmed on an impact trajectory with a densely populated area. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the impact prediction system.
quests.explanation: Impact prediction systems refine trajectory and landing zone estimates to within kilometers as debris approaches.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Evacuate the predicted impact zone with a five-hour warning before entry. Input code!
quests.hint: Evacuate the predicted impact zone.
quests.explanation: Impact zone evacuations use predicted footprint models to define the minimum area needing clearance for resident safety.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International space agencies coordinating public information on the impact event. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the coordinated space agency media briefing.
quests.explanation: Coordinated space agency briefings prevent contradictory public guidance and reduce panic during debris impact events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear criticality accident occurring at a fuel processing facility. Input code!
quests.hint: Execute the criticality stop procedure.
quests.explanation: Criticality stop procedures add neutron-absorbing materials and disperse the fissile configuration to halt the chain reaction.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Lethal radiation doses being received by workers in the immediate accident area. Input code!
quests.hint: Evacuate all workers from the lethal radiation zone.
quests.explanation: Lethal zone evacuations are executed in under 60 seconds; every additional second increases irreversible radiation injury.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Medical physicists needed immediately to assess the worker radiation doses received. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy medical physicists to the scene.
quests.explanation: Medical physicists perform accurate dose reconstruction to guide treatment decisions for radiation-exposed workers.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Coordinated cyber-physical attack affecting power and water utilities simultaneously. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the cyber-physical infrastructure defense.
quests.explanation: Cyber-physical defense teams address digital intrusion and physical sabotage simultaneously using integrated response protocols.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Incident crosses three state jurisdictions requiring federal intervention. Input code!
quests.hint: Engage federal emergency authorities immediately.
quests.explanation: Federal engagement provides resources and legal authority beyond any single state and coordinates multi-jurisdictional response.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Classified attack attribution data being shared with allied security agencies. Input code!
quests.hint: Share attack attribution intelligence with allies.
quests.explanation: Allied intelligence sharing provides additional analysis capabilities and enables coordinated diplomatic or military response.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Highly transmissible pathogen crossing international borders via air travel. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate international border health screening.
quests.explanation: Border health screening intercepts travelers with symptoms and prevents infected individuals from seeding new disease clusters.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International airport operations modified to support universal passenger screening. Input code!
quests.hint: Implement universal airport health scanning.
quests.explanation: Universal health scanning prevents any infected traveler from passing through without detection and quarantine.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Bilateral health treaties being invoked for cross-border treatment and isolation. Input code!
quests.hint: Invoke bilateral health emergency treaties.
quests.explanation: Bilateral health treaties provide legal frameworks for cross-border patient treatment and quarantine enforcement.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National-level mass evacuation order required for 2 million residents. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the national mass evacuation order.
quests.explanation: National mass evacuation orders coordinate transport, shelter, and resource allocation for population movements measured in millions.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Transportation infrastructure approaching saturation under evacuation demand. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the transportation coordination authority.
quests.explanation: Transportation coordination authority commandeers additional vehicles, opens contra-flow lanes, and manages fuel supply.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Reception areas must be prepared before the evacuating population wave arrives. Input code!
quests.hint: Prepare reception areas for the evacuating population.
quests.explanation: Reception area preparation ensures food, water, medical care, and registration systems are ready before residents arrive.
